morphology.pattern_note: 英语地名，整词记忆；不能按马来语词缀拆分。规范书写为 Pittsburgh；英语读音中的词尾 h 不单独发音。

senses.zh_definition: 匹兹堡：美国宾夕法尼亚州的一座城市。
senses.en_definition: A city in Pennsylvania, United States.
senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah bandar di negeri Pennsylvania, Amerika Syarikat.
senses.nuances: 专有地名，正文中首字母大写。此处提供编者释义；资料包没有提供 DBP 释义，不能据此认证为马来语官方词条。frequency_rank 仅沿用输入排名；搭配为自然用例，未经频率统计。地名来源参见 [Pittsburgh 市政府](https://www.pittsburghpa.gov/City-Government/City-Information/Pittsburghs-Flag-Great-Seal)。IPA 采用 [Cambridge 的美式读音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/pittsburgh)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 该大学代表团将赴匹兹堡参加国际会议。
dual_scenarios.en: The university delegation will attend an international conference in Pittsburgh.

etymology.historical_story: Pittsburgh preserves a personal name inside a place name. In 1758, General John Forbes named the settlement in honour of William Pitt the Elder. For Malay learners, this history explains why Pittsburgh travels between languages as a geographical name rather than acquiring a meaning through Malay affixes. [Source: Pittsburgh city government](https://www.pittsburghpa.gov/City-Government/City-Information/Pittsburghs-Flag-Great-Seal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Pittsburgh 与中文“匹兹堡”成对记忆；看到词尾 h，记住它不单独发音。
